Settled Hellcat launched rolling (Launch) 2 m before a rigid concrete wall, neutral, no brakes. Crush: cabin travel from the first wall force above 5 kN until the cabin stops. Energy created: largest rise of (kinetic + gravity + elastic + torsion + pressure + driveline + damping + plastic + breaking) above its value at the contact start; the wall and the ground are passive, so this sum may only fall. Energies in kJ by material.
